sources.snippet: The old pseudo-model named "OpenCode" is gone from the picker: choose the model you want and PorkiCoder chooses the harness. Existing Kimi, GLM, and legacy OpenCode preferences migrate safely to the new default; Kimi and GLM remain available to independent fan-out and HogCode workflows.

sources.title: Changelog - PorkiCoder IDE
sources.snippet: GLM-5.2 is now selectable in PorkiCoder chat and Agent Mode, available through the ChatView agent picker, and exposed in opencode's PorkiCoder provider as a server-funded model. Signed-in users route through PorkiCoder's Baseten-backed proxy with thinking enabled, while BYOK terminals receive the same Baseten key wiring used by the Kimi models.

sources.title: walidsi/pi-herdr-tab-namer - GitHub
sources.snippet: pi-herdr-tab-namer A Pi extension that renames the current Herdr tab from a short summary of your first prompt in the session. Summarization runs in the background against a separate, pre-configured model — it never delays your prompt and never appears in the chat transcript.
